test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 16 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
This question has two statements followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. You have to decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the given statements.

Statements:

All bags are purses.

No purse is a wallet.

Conclusions

(I) At least some wallets are purses.

(II) No bag is a wallet.
solution:
**Statements:**

All bags are purses.

No purse is a wallet.

The least possible Venn diagram is given:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1179ea438e5a57c77602ea00990dec33be716da6a99cbed4812b3c974a008b2b.png] 

**Conclusions**

(I) At least some wallets are purses - **False**(Because, No purse is a wallet is given , it implies that no wallets are purses).

(II) No bag is a wallet - **True**(Because, All bags are purses and No purse is a wallet is given, it implies that no bag is wallet).

Thus, Only conclusion (II) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
